notes.title: Patch v 1.1.3 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for your feedback regarding the 1.1.2 Update. We have updated the game to remove Red Shell based on the complaints we received from players.

v1.1.3
- We have removed the third party plugin called Red Shell.

v1.1.2

- The game now saves during tutorial but only after each SOL. This was requested by several players as the tutorial can take long to complete. 

- We have optimized the performace of the game heavily which means the game should run faster and get a higher frame rate. The loading times should also be faster. Additionally, the overall game size has also been reduced. 

- We increased the tutorial text size in the game since it was a bit too small to read for some players. 

- (Removed in 1.1.3) We have integrated Red Shell, a third party plugin that helps us improve our reach to players. Please take a look at the following thread for more details regarding this: 
https://steamcommunity.com/app/505730/discussions/0/1696049513769369723/

Lastly, if you have any concerns or feedback, please do let us know! You can find us on Discord at https://discord.me/holypotatoes ;)

Happy crewing!

notes.notes:

Spudlings!

The brand spankin' new ship skins are finally here! You can now head to the Customization tab and select new skins for your ship!

The skins are linked to Steam achievements, so if you have already churned out some achievements you may already see new ship skins and don't have to worry about unlocking them!

Happy Exploring Spudlings!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0 is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26000170/e1cdb8f84cadffc32f4e734b1252895bec19546b.gif

Hellooooo all spududes and spudettes!

All spaced out? No worries, we’ve got your back! It's been more than a month since the release of Holy Potatoes! We're in Space?! and after reading through all the feedback, we got to crackin’ behind the scenes and BAM! We can finally present our first big update to the world! If you’ve read our dev diary Behind the Spud (psst, if you haven’t, check it out!), you may already have an inkling of what’s to come!

Here are all the in-depth deets of this new patch:

Version 1.1.0

Version Highlights
Players may now unlock the Space Cat as a Pilot! (How, you ask? That’s for you to find out…)
There are now more Random Encounters added into the pool! Look out for them!
Couch Potato (Casual) Mode Added! In this mode, you can now play endlessly in each Galaxy for as long as you’d like before proceeding to the next Galaxy! Achievements will not be unlocked in this mode, though!


Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue causing Repair Crews and Guardian Angel to trigger even after all Encounters rather than only after Combat Encounters, as the Research’s text suggests.
Fixed an issue causing UI during combat to act strangely at times.
Fixed various text issues in all languages.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26000170/83b42d7e99c621a1a40e3443fadfd1b310614e60.jpg

Hey everyone!

Like last week, we took everyone's advice and pushed a small update addressing some of the game's issues! Below you will find the changelog for this week's patch:
___________________________________________________________________

Bug Fixes
General

Fixed some minor issues with regards to variable display errors.
Fixed a bug that was causing the Final Siege 100% completion achievement to not be triggered.
Fixed a bug that was causing the typewriter sound to be played repeatedly when skipping to a choice in a cutscene.
Fixed some minor issues with regards to UI not showing up appropriately in a few situations.
Fixed an issue that was causing flavor descriptions for Living Quarters upgrades to not be shown.
Boosts for Level 3 Therapy and Level 5 Training Room adjusted so that there is a gain in boost every level.
Level 5 Training Room now has Instant Skill Level 4 (was 3)
Level 4 Therapy Room now has Instant Complete 15% (was 10%)

Other Changes
The Hub should now restore Hull HP and Fuel every Sol.
Level 7 Shield Generators and Charge Capacitors now appear in Galaxy 7 rather than Galaxy 8.
Some adjustments to Crafting chances.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26000170/d9b5a68f55d1a209a72e0e2b73e464e0a80bd4e8.gif

Hey guys!

We just wanted to let everybody know that our first update is now LIVE! We have made some tweaks to the game in regards to balancing and bug fixes. Also, we have taken some of your suggestions and implemented them into the game!

For one, we have removed the $tarch price for putting your spuds in therapy! Also, we have made it a little easier to traverse through the shield portion of the tutorial.

Another major addition to the game was the Chinese translation, meaning the game will now be available in Chinese (simplified) as well! In addition, we ever so slightly polished up the translations for Japanese, Russian, and Polish.

Lastly, we have added Linux support to the game!

For a detailed changelog of everything included in Patch 1.0.1, we have outlined everything below.

HAPPY GAMING!
________________________________________________________

Bug fixes
General

Fixed some issues with regards to objectives in a late-game galaxy
Fixed some phase transition issues in some Boss Fights. 
Fixed text that was showing up incorrectly in Random Encounters and Skills. 
Fixed some issues with displaying the wrong sprite in some situations with random encounters and battles.

Upgrades

The initial boosts for the Training Room and Crafting Workshop now occur at Level 3

Weapons

Fixed an issue with the [spoiler]Primordial Starfall[/spoiler] not performing its intended effect while [spoiler]Aether[/spoiler] is active.

Cutscenes

Fixed an issue that sometimes caused characters to display strangely when skipping cutscenes to various junctures where a choice by the player is required.

Balance Tweaks
Exploration

Tweaked the rates at which some Choice Encounters occur
“Traffic Jam” should occur less often now.
Generally increased the damage dealt by punishing choices
Generally increased the rewards given from Choice Encounters
Generally increased the rewards given from completing Explorations

Research

All Research Costs have been rebalanced across the board in order to make it generally less easy to obtain high tier Researches until later in the game.

Bosses

Reduced a certain boss’ difficulty by approximately 20%, particularly in terms of health and skill damage.
Improved the weapon health of a few bosses.
Added an additional phase for the [spoiler]Necronomicon[/spoiler] boss.
Increased Max Charge for the [spoiler]Necronomicon[/spoiler] boss so that it can now fire up to 2 weapons simultaneously from time to time
Changed some completion rewards for yet another boss.
Phase transitions for a certain other boss have been revised.

Weapons

All weapons' attack tweaked across the board, especially for Unique weapons that Hit All and apply debuffs/buffs. Typically, weapons that apply multiple debuffs/buffs should do more damage now.
[spoiler]Robbing Hood's[/spoiler] Charge Cost has been increased by 1, which also increases damage by about 10%.
[spoiler]Luna's Aegis[/spoiler] now heals for 100% of its attack rather than 50%.

Other Changes

Hub Planet appearance will now change from galaxy to galaxy.
Added a highlight on the corresponding shield button in order to make the tutorial easier to follow.
Reduced the speed at which battle rewards appear and disappear from the screen, which should allow a little more time to read it.
Removed $tarch Cost for Trauma
Some overall graphic improvements for various skills and weapons.

notes.title: Linux Release and Chinese Localization
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We are only a couple of hours away from release! We are all super excited here at Daylight Studios even though it is nearing midnight :D

I know this announcement is last minute and it comes with a heavy heart that we have to say this, but due to some unforeseen circumstances we have had to push back the release date of the Linux version of Holy Potatoes! We're in Space?! Although we have thoroughly tested on Linux, there are still a few critical bugs that occur here and there and we cannot justify releasing it at the same time as the Mac and Windows versions. Having said that, we are still testing the ever living spud out of it and it should be released sooner rather than later.

As for the Chinese (Simplified) localization, there have been some complications with it and we have determined that the quality of it is just not up to par, so we will also have to push this back and it will not be released with the game in a couple hours. All other languages are accounted for and will be available as soon as the game comes out though!

Thanks again to everyone for all the support and we are sorry we have had to push a couple of things back, but we are still super excited and looking forward to releasing Holy Potatoes! We're in Space?! in a couple hours :D
